column1: # The applang corpus: each program in the repo that compiles and shows a widget, once
# by the FNV-1a 64 hash of its text, and the variants of each (names renamed, states
# reordered) that compile too. shape: its hash but for names, comments and spacing.
# runs: no fault on smoke seeds 1 to 3, icon drawable. held: measured, never trained
# on; a tenth of the shapes, with every program of them. The corpus's id hashes each
# line but its last column (where a program was found). Derived: `cargo run -p
# compusophy-lab --release -- corpus` writes it; never edit it by hand.
# 578 programs: 101 found, 477 variants, 91 shapes; 399 run clean; 71 held out.
